hook.name: ZealzNativeOpeningHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 launchpad hook for ETH-paired token launches supporting batch and instant openings. Charges split fees on every swap (ETH leg) distributed to a buyback furnace, creator, platform, and token holders; instant-launch pools add a decaying surcharge up to 95% in the first minute to deter snipers, waivable via a signed pass for zealz.fun users.
